 equipment inspection I1 which must be performed for the full gas 
 Strainer
 every six months 
 as indicated by M6 in the title block or the periodic fuel gas analysis 
 report refers to abnormal or strange impurities or liquid contained with the 
 fuel gas came from the purchasers lines

The first draft initiated by 
 eng. Amr Ahmed Gad, tested by eng. El-Sayed Mahmoud El-kholy, accepted by

 and approved by eng. Solman Zaki Soliman general manager of inspection

items:
A work permit must 
 be issued and 
 the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.

Safety fence with 
 caution marks surrounding the work area is required

Wear your safety 
 helmet, safety shoes, eye glass

Insure that no 
 spark source or lighting cigarettes exist

Insure that the 
 inlet valve firmly closed

Insure that the 
 valve is opened and plugged and the vented gas stopped

The strainer screen 
 must be cleaned by solvent detergent

During operation, clean by opening blow down valve, (with 
 exposing the flat mirror) from dirt, scale, etc.

During shutdown if there is dirt, scale, other strange things 
 you must close the inlet valve and the line after the inlet valve vented to 
 atmosphere, and open the blow-down valve
Take out the strainer and clean with the suitable solvent cleaner

Reassemble the strainer and retighten the flange and flange 
 bolts

Open the inlet gas valve slightly until the line after the 
 inlet valve and its priming and pressurized
Close the vent valve and its plug
Complete to open the inlet fuel gas valve

text:
Power 
 Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document out lines the 
 equipment inspection I1 which must be performed for the full gas 
 Strainer
 every six months 
 as indicated by M6 in the title block or the periodic fuel gas analysis 
 report refers to abnormal or strange impurities or liquid contained with the 
 fuel gas came from the purchasers lines
The first draft initiated by 
 eng. Amr Ahmed Gad, tested by eng. El-Sayed Mahmoud El-kholy, accepted by 
 general manager eng. Sawsan El Lithe, revised by eng. Nasser Bahgat MPIS coordinator, 
 and approved by eng. Solman Zaki Soliman general manager of inspection 
 and quality insurance.
Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must 
 be issued and 
 the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with 
 caution marks surrounding the work area is required
Wear your safety 
 helmet, safety shoes, eye glass
Insure that no 
 spark source or lighting cigarettes exist
Insure that the 
 inlet valve firmly closed
Insure that the 
 valve is opened and plugged and the vented gas stopped
The strainer screen 
 must be cleaned by solvent detergent
Tools 
and Equipment
Complete maintenance 
 tool set.
Flat mirror
Rags, cleaning fluid.
Work to be 
carried out
During operation, clean by opening blow down valve, (with 
 exposing the flat mirror) from dirt, scale, etc.
During shutdown if there is dirt, scale, other strange things 
 you must close the inlet valve and the line after the inlet valve vented to 
 atmosphere, and open the blow-down valve
Loose the strainer flange bolts
Take out the strainer and clean with the suitable solvent cleaner
Reassemble the strainer and retighten the flange and flange 
 bolts
Close the blow - down valve
Open the inlet gas valve slightly until the line after the 
 inlet valve and its priming and pressurized
Close the vent valve and its plug
Complete to open the inlet fuel gas valve
